name: freepress-desktop
description: FreePress - Private, Censorship-Proof, Autonomous Publishing Desktop Application
author: Shubham Rasal

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "electron ."
scripts.package: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --linux
